title: A Microlocal Description of Aubert-Zelevinsky Duality on Unipotent $L$-Parameters
summary: We give a microlocal description of the Aubert--Zelevinsky involution for all unipotent representations of all inner forms of simple adjoint unramified $p$-adic groups. Via the realization of enhanced $L$-parameters as perverse sheaves, we show that the involution corresponds to the composition of three operations on an endoscopic subgroup: Fourier transform, Chevalley involution and duality on local systems.
